human_decision.justification:
The event looks dangerous: 20 failed logins, 43 MB of data sent out,
198 processes, and a login from Russia.
But I cannot confirm it is a real attack. Nobody checked the computer
itself. The account name (svc-backup) suggests a backup service,
so sending a lot of data could be normal
The AI was 100% sure and the Meta-AI raised no questions, which is
too confident for this evidence.
Isolating a server is a big step. Before approving it, I would check
the processes on host-02, check the IP address 185.220.101.5, and
check if a backup was scheduled at that time.
